items.title: US Treasury expands Operation Economic Outcast against Iran proxy networks
items.title_zh: 美财政部扩大“经济放逐”行动，打击伊朗代理金融网
items.summary_zh: 财政部OFAC于9月10日再宣布制裁，瞄准支持伊拉克真主党旅（Kata’ib Hizballah）与黎巴嫩真主党等网络，属8月24日启动的“经济放逐行动”。国务院同步点名IRGC-QF借伊拉克人民动员力量与商业渠道洗钱避制裁。OFAC并发布对伊许可“推定拒绝”政策，直至伊朗改变在霍尔木兹与海湾的行为。

quotes.author: U.S. Treasury / OFAC
quotes.en: Today's action targets entities and individuals that support Kata'ib Hizballah (KH) and Hizballah.
quotes.zh: 今日行动针对支持伊拉克真主党旅与真主党的实体和个人。

items.title: CUDA for AMD on Windows
items.title_zh: Windows上的AMD CUDA：兼容层再进一步
items.summary_zh: 社区推进在Windows为AMD GPU提供CUDA兼容路径。约104赞，焦点在开放标准（HIP/SYCL/OpenCL）与“CUDA会否沦为中间表示”。

quotes.author: linuxhansl
quotes.en: Off-topic and somewhat of a rant, but I'd far prefer us all focusing on open standards like HIP, SYCL, OpenCL, etc. It's unbearable that most LLM inference happens on closed H/W, closed drivers, and closed SDKs.
quotes.zh: 有点跑题也像抱怨：我更希望大家聚焦HIP、SYCL、OpenCL等开放标准。大多数LLM推理跑在封闭硬件、封闭驱动与封闭SDK上，实在难以忍受。

quotes.author: swerner
quotes.en: AI will take down Nvidia’s moat. When it becomes trivial to translate CUDA/PTX to HIP, SYCL or Metal, CUDA is no longer the moat, it becomes the intermediate representation.
quotes.zh: AI会拆掉英伟达护城河。当CUDA/PTX翻译到HIP、SYCL或Metal变得琐碎，CUDA就不再是护城河，而变成中间表示。

items.title: UN envoy warns Yemen war enters more dangerous phase after Mocha seizure
items.title_zh: 联合国特使警告：穆哈易手后也门战争进入更危险阶段
items.summary_zh: BBC等证实胡塞从沙特支持的政府军手中夺取穆哈，并推进至祖卡尔岛等地；有官员称政府军撤离后胡塞船只抵达佩里姆（Mayyun）岛附近。联合国特使在安理会称国际社会须应对“新的更危险阶段”，穆哈易手使胡塞直接出现在曼德海峡接近路径。沙特联军持续空袭，巴基斯坦向伊朗转达约束胡塞的警告。

quotes.author: BBC News
quotes.en: Yemen's Houthis have seized the strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed pro-government forces, military sources and witnesses say.
quotes.zh: 军方消息人士与目击者称，也门胡塞武装已从沙特支持的亲政府部队手中夺取红海战略港口穆哈。

items.fetch_notes: NM首页HTTP 429；据BBC/Al Jazeera/UN公开报道估分6.4

items.title: 'Fingerprints' inside the Sun could reveal if it once swallowed a planet
items.title_zh: 太阳内部“指纹”或揭示它曾吞并行星
items.summary_zh: 研究提出太阳内部化学/振荡“指纹”可能保留早期吞并行星痕迹。HN约97赞，评论要求按HN规范链到论文原题，并赞叹MESA恒星演化软件社区。

quotes.author: spectraldrift
quotes.en: This might just be me, but I find metaphors like ''Fingerprints' inside the Sun' harder to read than the title of the original paper, which is probably what should be linked here per HN submission guidelines: > Planetary engulfment as a solution to solar-model discrepancies and its implications for planetary systems https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stag1527 For the press release, something like *The Real Sun and Its Simulations Disagree. A Planet That Fell In Early Might Explain It.* might be…
quotes.zh: 也许只有我这么想，但“太阳内部指纹”这类隐喻标题比论文原题更难读——按HN提交规范或许该链原题：《行星吞并作为太阳模型差异与……的一种解释》。

quotes.author: mturk
quotes.en: MESA, a piece of software referenced in this article, is a pretty incredible system. (Even referring to it as software underplays the extent of its community and impact.) Many people are involved in MESA and Bill Paxton was always quick to point out the many new folks that worked on it, but this article does a great job of celebrating his impact: https://www.kitp.ucsb.edu/news/an-accidental-astrophysicist It's amazing to me that he went from being the voice on the other end of the Mother Of All…
quotes.zh: 文中提到的MESA是一套惊人的系统（叫它“软件”都低估了社区与影响）。很多人参与其中，Bill Paxton总急着指出后来加入的新贡献者。

items.title: US average diesel price tops $6 a gallon amid Iran war fuel crunch
items.title_zh: 伊朗战事推高燃料紧缺：美国柴油均价史上破每加仑6美元
items.summary_zh: 柴油全国均价首次超过每加仑6美元；分析指中东炼厂扰动、霍尔木兹与红海双通道承压、战略石油储备处于约44年低位，使柴油比原油更紧。卡车物流与通胀预期同步升温，市场重新定价全球央行路径。Pickering警告：这已不只是美国通胀问题。

quotes.author: Dan Pickering / Fortune
quotes.en: The risk that this shows up in inflation is growing—not just U.S. inflation, but global inflation.
quotes.zh: 这反映到通胀上的风险在上升——不只是美国通胀，而是全球通胀。

items.title: Making Startups Powerful
items.title_zh: 让初创公司更强大：组织与杠杆笔记
items.summary_zh: 关于强化初创杠杆——招聘、决策与全栈吞客户——的长文。HN约92赞，评论回顾对PG随笔态度转向的拐点，以及“帮客户做最难的事直到吃进核心流程”的变体。

quotes.author: raincole
quotes.en: I wonder what the tipping point was where the general attitude towards PG and his essays changed. It's tempting to say AI, but I feel it was more like AirBnB era? When people saw how one of YC's golden goose affected the local communities, the rosy color on our glasses inevitably faded.
quotes.zh: 好奇大众对PG及其随笔的态度是在哪个临界点转向的。很想怪AI，但我感觉更像Airbnb时代：当人们看到YC金鹅如何冲击本地社区，滤镜就不可避免地碎了。

quotes.author: bob1029
quotes.en: > There's a variant of going full stack where you eat your way gradually through the customer by doing all their hardest work for them. One of my clients provisions front office applications for banks and the conversation has come up more than once regarding the client evolving into a bank themselves and building up operations around the capabilities of the product stack. One good multi-regional partner and it could be a radically different animal. Providing software to one very big customer…
quotes.zh: 有一种全栈变体：你逐渐替客户做完他们最难的活，从而把客户吃进去。我有个为银行交付前台应用的客户，关于要不要演化成……的对话出现过不止一次。

items.title: Arctic drone hits expose new risks for Russian gas and European markets
items.title_zh: 北极无人机打击暴露俄气与欧洲市场新风险
items.summary_zh: 彭博报道称，乌无人机飞行逾3200公里打击亚马尔两座凝析气加工厂，揭示克里姆林宫能源产业与全球市场的新脆弱点：该地带贡献俄约八成天然气产量。欧洲在霍尔木兹受阻、TTF大涨与储气偏低背景下，任何俄气节点扰动都会被迅速定价；审计院同时批评成员国替代能源投资不足。

quotes.author: Bloomberg News
quotes.en: Ukraine's unprecedented attacks on Russia's gas assets in a remote Arctic region revealed new risks for the Kremlin's battered energy industry and the global market.
quotes.zh: 乌克兰对俄偏远北极天然气资产的空前打击，揭示了克里姆林宫承压能源产业与全球市场的新风险。

items.title: Global Shortage Has Led to Motor Oil Rationing at Costco
items.title_zh: 全球短缺导致Costco机油限购
items.summary_zh: 报道称机油供应紧张已传导至Costco限购。HN约88赞，评论回溯数月前预警帖，并挂钩战略石油储备逼近法定下限。与同日柴油破6美元形成零售注脚。

quotes.author: arjie
quotes.en: Huh, neat. There was this Twitter chap who said this was going to happen a few months ago. It was a fun interaction[0]: > > > *Just got word Mobil and Shell have informed Costco and Walmart they have no packaged product to send them and to expect bare shelves in the motor oil section in a few weeks* > > *Lol as if youd be the first person anyone tells.* > *I am Chevrons largest passenger vehicle lubricant purchaser lol* 0: https://x.com/CostaKapo/status/2053948679485009990?s=20
quotes.zh: 有意思。几个月前推特上有人说过这会发生，当时互动挺好玩：有人声称已获悉Mobil与Shell通知Costco和Walmart没有灌装成品可发，机油货架会空。

quotes.author: 3eb7988a1663
quotes.en: Things are really about to hit the fan. The world has been surviving off of strategic petroleum reserves, but those are quickly hitting the bottom. The US last reported at 285M barrels[0]. There is a legal floor of ~250M, after which it is reserved for government national defense. Usage has been all over the place, but the drawdown has been somewhere in the region of 1M barrels per day. Public analyses have said that the cavern integrity becomes threatened once levels fall below 300M. Current…
quotes.zh: 事情真要砸风扇了。世界一直靠战略石油储备撑着，但库存很快见底。美国最近报285百万桶，法定下限约250百万桶，之后优先留给国防。

items.title: NASA Sentinel-6 duo tracks late-blooming 2026 El Niño near hurricane peak
items.title_zh: NASA哨兵-6双星追踪晚发强厄尔尼诺，正值飓风季高峰
items.summary_zh: NASA/JPL称Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich与Sentinel-6B以约30秒间距交叉校准海面高度，追踪2026年“晚发”强厄尔尼诺。项目科学家Josh Willis称其年中才启动，强度已接近1997与2015年级事件，并已产生显著影响。同一测高数据同时服务毫米级海平面气候记录与大西洋飓风暖池预报。

quotes.author: Josh Willis / NASA JPL
quotes.en: This El Niño was a late-bloomer. It didn't kick off until the middle of the year and is just now reaching a strength similar to what we've seen in the satellite record during significant El Niños in 1997 and 2015.
quotes.zh: 这场厄尔尼诺是“晚发”的：直到年中才启动，强度现在才接近卫星记录中1997与2015年那些显著事件。

items.fetch_notes: NM首页HTTP 429；据NASA/JPL公开信息与Cosmic Herald整理估分4.9

items.title: Romania soccer introduces black card to 'combat abusive behaviour' from parents
items.title_zh: 罗马尼亚足球引入黑牌，惩戒球迷虐待行为
items.summary_zh: 罗马尼亚足协试验“黑牌”以应对球场虐待与歧视。HN约69赞，评论指出应链官方稿，并质疑弃赛对积分与“故意制造黑牌中止败局”的扭曲激励。

quotes.author: layer8
quotes.zh: 实际来源在这里：罗马尼亚足协英文稿《FRF引入黑牌以打击虐待行为》。

quotes.author: hakunin
quotes.en: I wonder how would this work in terms of fairness to the team that's likely to win. If a match is abandoned, what does it mean for progressing in a tournament, etc. Could there be a perverse incentive to cause a black card to abort a lost game? I'm sure this has all been thought through, but the article doesn't seem to say anything about it.
quotes.zh: 好奇这对很可能赢球的一方是否公平。若比赛被放弃，对晋级意味着什么？会不会出现故意制造黑牌以中止必败局的扭曲激励？想必他们想过，但细节决定一切。
